tail: Photorealistic photograph for a practical home cleaning how-to video. A bright tidy kitchen with painted sage green wooden cabinets and a stainless steel range hood, light wood countertop, soft daylight. Adult hands, rolled-up sleeves of a burgundy red cotton shirt, no face visible. 16:9 landscape format. No text, no letters, no numbers, no brand names, no logos, no watermark.
